In a spine with healthy discs the diseased level stands out: on T2 the degenerated disc loses the bright nuclear signal and becomes lower.
Degenerative spondylolisthesis results from wear of the disc and facet joints; it mainly affects L4-L5 and may narrow the canal and lateral recesses, causing neurogenic claudication. Isthmic listhesis (from spondylolysis) is instead typical of L5-S1.
The grade is measured with Meyerding (I up to 25% of the endplate). Mild slips are best seen by following the posterior wall line; on supine MRI they may appear smaller than on standing radiographs.
Listesi a L4-L5: pensa alla forma degene: Listhesis at L4-L5: think degenerative; at L5-S1: look for spondylolysis.
Gradazioni del radiologo muscoloscheletr: Grading by the SPIDER collection musculoskeletal radiologist: L4-L5 spondylolisthesis, upper and lower endplate changes, disc narrowing, bulge, Pfirrmann 3; L5-S1 Pfirrmann 2; upper levels Pfirrmann 1.
